sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS Unless we state otherwise in the prospectus supplement, we expect to use all of the net proceeds from the sale of the securities described in this prospectus for general corporate purposes, including, but not limited to, any of the following: repayment of outstanding debt, capital expenditures, investments in subsidiaries, working capital, repurchases of shares of our outstanding common stock, acquisitions and other business opportunities.
